# netactuate_nke_kubeconfig (Resource)

Issues a kubeconfig for an NKE cluster once and keeps it in state; the next apply after it expires replaces it. The kubeconfig holds a cluster-admin token, stored in plain text in the Terraform state: protect the state. Destroying the resource does not revoke the token; it stays valid until it expires.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netactuate_nke_kubeconfig" "example" {
  cluster_id         = 12345
  expiration_seconds = 604800
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (Number) The NKE cluster ID

### Optional

- `expiration_seconds` (Number) Requested token lifetime in seconds. The minimum lifetime is 7 days (604800), which is also the default

### Read-Only

- `expires_on` (String) When the token expires (RFC 3339), from its exp claim. The next apply after that replaces the kubeconfig
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `kubeconfig` (String, Sensitive) The kubeconfig YAML for accessing the cluster
